title: Go, Cat, Go!
summary: A brave cat answers the call to help find a lost toy, discovering courage within itself.

pages.scene: A small gray cat sitting peacefully in a cozy home
Cat's ordinary day, napping in sunlight
Child pointing at a toy that has rolled away into a dark corner
Child calling to the cat with excitement and hope
Cat stepping forward bravely toward the dark space
Cat discovering the toy in the shadows
Cat carrying toy back to child triumphantly
Child hugging the cat, both happy and celebrating
